{"source_id":"MS002-SRC-A","verdicts":[
{"claim_id":"CL-0301","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0492 and EV-0493 state he will feed an image of a product and an image of an influencer and get the influencer to talk about the product, and that this is actually multiple steps.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0492","EV-0493"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0302","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0493 states he goes first not to video but to image to generate using image models, and EV-0494 states he references the previously generated midnight clay image and finds a UGC style influencer on Pinterest.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0493","EV-0494"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0303","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0495 states most of the time it's a woman demoing a product because mathematically they found women demoing products do a lot better.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0495"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0304","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0496 calls auto size important and says it depends on how videos will be generated, and EV-0497 says for simplicity he goes one one and assumes everything is generated one.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0496","EV-0497"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0305","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0497 states batch size is just the total number of gens created with these two images.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0497"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0306","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0498 gives the prompt verbatim including all features but ultimately different, change her hair, indoors instead of outdoors, because she will be used in a product shoot later.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0497","EV-0498"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0307","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0498 and EV-0499 together state generating three options is going to cost 21 credits.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0498","EV-0499"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0308","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0499 and EV-0500 describe taking the woman, sticking her in a fake indoor environment he made, and using the now-fake woman to advertise products by turning that into a video, called the three or four step flow.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0499","EV-0500"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0309","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0500 states he always likes doing this manually at least once before fully automating with cloud (Claude) code, and EV-0501 continues that otherwise you're just misunderstanding the different features and options available.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0500","EV-0501"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0310","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0501 states he generated in 2K, that 1K is just 1024 pixels, and that for really high quality input images for video it's better to do this with a high 2K.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0501"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0311","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0502 lists Higsfield Soul, Higsfield Soul Cinema, Cream 5.0 Pro and free usage at time of recording as an advertising play, and EV-0503 specifies incentivizing last-gen, cheap-inference models.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0502","EV-0503"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0312","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0503 says it is not occurring instantly because it is quite computationally intensive and EV-0504 says they are using GBT image 2 generating 2048 pixel images.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0503","EV-0504"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0313","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0505 and EV-0506 show him referencing the chosen image plus the generated woman with a prompt to have her hold the product in a bathroom where it would make sense, enthusiastic but not overselling.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0505","EV-0506"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0314","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0506 and EV-0507 state he generated three last time to give himself diversity of options, finds he doesn't really need it since it does a pretty good job, so he one-shotted it, and mentions doing 2K again.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0506","EV-0507"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0315","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0509, EV-0510 and EV-0511 show him giving Claude Code the product image and asking for three scripts similar to a real influencer, pretending the influencer is a young woman who found value, around 30 seconds.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0509","EV-0510","EV-0511"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0316","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0512 has him say it's not really all that good and he'll edit it slightly, and EV-0513/EV-0514 give the edited version ending with this is going to be my little script for the video.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0512","EV-0513","EV-0514"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0317","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0514 notes she's now holding it in a bathroom and EV-0515 says he's now going to turn it into a video.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0514","EV-0515"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0318","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0515 mentions a variety of models and trying C dance 2.0 fast, EV-0518 mentions cling and trying a bunch of models to see which work best, and EV-0519 mentions Cling Turbo and Cance 2.0.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0515","EV-0518","EV-0519"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0319","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0516 gives the prompt 'a woman influencer doing a UGC style ad talking about a product' and says for starters he'll make it really small.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0516"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0320","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0517 states that without uploading media it sometimes won't keep the midnight clay mask in the right place, that he adds it as an element with a name and description so it has access for the video, and EV-0518 says it's actually added to the prompt box as the prop.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0516","EV-0517","EV-0518"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0321","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0518 says he turns on sound and generates 10 with cling, and EV-0519 says he does the same with Cling Turbo and Cance 2.0 to test a couple of different approaches.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0518","EV-0519"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0322","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0520 states they generated a pretty short one as a test to make sure they could hear audio and it didn't seem super crazy.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0520"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0323","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0521 says he'll try a variety of models and you can expect to spend maybe $10 to $20 doing this initial test round, and EV-0521/EV-0522 state the whole idea is you want a reusable pipeline.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0521","EV-0522"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0324","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0522 raises the time issue and EV-0523 states he'll max it out at like 15 seconds, that Gemini Omni Flash is only 10 seconds, and that they need to make this a little bit shorter.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0522","EV-0523"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0325","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0528 states he checks word counter and it's about 146 characters, and EV-0529 states he'll go to like 170 characters, or in words 27 to maybe like 30 words.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0528","EV-0529"]}
]}
